fields.name: Sudhānidhi Rāya
fields.notes:
Kāyastha of Orissa, son of Bhavānanda Rāya and younger brother of Rāmānanda Rāya; one of the five brothers who were branches of Śrī Caitanya (Caitanya-caritāmṛta Ādi 10.133).

In Kṛṣṇa-līlā: one of the nine nidhis (Gaura-gaṇoddeśa-dīpikā 102-103); Acyutānanda dāsa (Gurubhakti-gītā, vol. 3, p. 176) calls him Sudhākara, the gopī Manoharī.

fields.name: Sāraṅga Ṭhākura
fields.place: Māmgāchi (Modadruma-dvīpa, Navadvīpa), under a bakula tree; born at Budhan (Abhirāma: Kuliyā); samādhi at Garbetā (Midnapore)
fields.notes:
Branch of Śrī Caitanya: «Bhāgavatācārya, Ṭhākura Sāraṅgadāsa» (Caitanya-caritāmṛta Ādi 10.113). Lived under a bakula tree in Navadvīpa and crossed the Gaṅgā every evening for the Lord's kīrtana. On the Lord's order he gave dīkṣā to the first person he met: a dead boy floating on the Gaṅgā, who came back to life and became Ṭhākura Murāri (not Murāri Gupta). The Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava Abhidhāna has two entries, Sāraṅgadāsa Ṭhākura and Sāraṅgadeva, «probably the same person».

In Kṛṣṇa-līlā: Nāndīmukhī (some say Prahlāda) (Gaura-gaṇoddeśa-dīpikā 172).
